description: Hourly funding rate history for a Hyperliquid perp, including HIP-3 builder perps. A positive rate means longs pay shorts.

limit.description: Number of funding rate entries (1-100, default 10)

market.description: Market symbol — native HL perp (e.g. "BTC-PERP", "ETH-PERP") or HIP-3 builder market namespaced as "<issuer>:<base>-PERP" (e.g. "flx:GAS-PERP", "xyz:NVDA-PERP")

name: get_funding_rates

base_market.description: Display symbol without the HIP-3 issuer prefix

issuer.description: HIP-3 builder code ("" for native markets)

rate.description: Hourly funding rate; positive means longs pay shorts

sequence.description: Order of the event within its block

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to fetch the next page; null on the last page
